Set the item_potion catalog price to 10 using the proper database authoring tool, retaining the rest of its record. The existing shop stock priceOverride:10 is correct and should be preserved. Leave the NPCs, maps, authored gates, and session defaults unchanged. Verify with an actual run_scene_test purchase (count 2, unitPrice 10) and expect goldDelta -20 and inventoryDelta item_potion +2; do not inject test state or change any acceptance expectation.
